name: Visitor Visa / Visitor Extension

requirements.blocker_text: Persons requiring a visa to visit, study, do business, or transit through the Cayman Islands must apply online to the Cayman Islands Visa Office; other nationalities may enter visa-free as visitors.

evidence_required.document: Visitor extension application, if extending stay

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the sources reviewed

sources.title: Cayman Islands Customs and Border Control (CBC) -- Visas & Extensions: confirms visa-required nationalities must apply online to the Cayman Islands Visa Office; visitor extensions available

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Cayman Islands' initial build -- the third British Overseas Territory (BOT) built this session, after Anguilla and Montserrat. Cayman's own local status, analogous to Belonger status elsewhere, is called 'Caymanian status' / 'the right to be Caymanian' -- see ky_caymanian_status_descent.json's notes for the full BOT-vs-citizenship framing decision applied throughout this country's routes. This visitor route itself is thin: the specific visa-required-nationality list, fees, and exact validity/extension periods were referenced but not detailed in the CBC pages fetched in this pass (deeper sub-pages exist but returned navigation-only content). CBC's own homepage text groups 'visit, study, do business or transit' under this same visa framework -- no evidence of a separate, longer-term dedicated student permit route was found in this pass, so study-purpose stays under this route rather than being split into its own file; flagged as a possible gap if a distinct student permit in fact exists.
